name: Tokage
source:
One of the three Hakkenshi that still remains in Son Faction other than Son and Souga. He is the leader of the 3rd Unit, which is the main active military force of the faction. He has a composed character but lacks attention to details. He often leaves all delicate works for his subordinates like Ryouto or Tomika to take care of. Perhaps because of his unserious nature, he gets along well with Souga, or rather tries to compete with him on a daily basis.
His full name is Tokage Gojuushisanshirou, but it is too long so everyone just calls him Tokage.
